subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical Google Chat @mentioned-Space drop bug, or should maintainers split/consolidate the remaining mention-detection work into a narrower Google Chat routing issue?
rationale: Source review shows a plausible remaining pre-session mention gate, and the latest reporter evidence says the classifier fix shipped but mention handling still blocks replies; choosing the canonical tracking shape and acceptable mention-detection behavior needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep As Canonical Mention-Gate Bug
options.body: Use this issue to require live Google Chat proof plus a focused mention/annotation fix for @mentioned Spaces.

options.title: Split To A Narrow Routing Issue
options.body: Open or designate a narrower Google Chat mention-detection issue, link this evidence there, and close this only after that canonical item exists.

options.title: Document Workaround Only
options.body: Treat `requireMention:false` or `botUser` setup as the supported path, but only after docs and probe diagnostics clearly explain the failure mode.

recommendation.title: Keep As Canonical Mention-Gate Bug
recommendation.body: Use this issue to require live Google Chat proof plus a focused mention/annotation fix for @mentioned Spaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across the Google Chat thread, ingress, and access-policy files implicated by the remaining fix boundary.
